description: A decoded field or typed value is not in its unique canonical encoding.
A statement or proof contains an undeclared section ID.
A statement or proof repeats a section ID.
Statement or proof sections are not in the required increasing order.
A container, section, or fixed-width value has the wrong length.
Bytes remain after the unique canonical container has been decoded.
The input profile or variant differs from the verifier-key profile.
The Structure stream is malformed or differs from the verifier-owned Structure.
A relation dimension or matrix count differs from the selected shape.
The common prefix injection, zero padding, or padded identity differs from v1.
A claim has an undeclared field, wrong authority, or verifier-owned shape value.
The PiCCS input does not contain one fresh and fourteen running sources.
A fresh source has a nonzero public-input field at index 257 through 269.
The PiCCS input relation, point, or output shape differs from PaddedRowIdentity.
A transcript operation occurs in the wrong mode or event position.
A challenge squeeze returns or consumes the wrong declared field count.
The joint SumCheck does not contain exactly twenty-four rounds.
A SumCheck round polynomial exceeds degree nine or has the wrong coefficient count.
A SumCheck round does not satisfy the current equals g(0) plus g(1) equation.
A SumCheck coefficient or round index is not in canonical order or encoding.
The PiCCS terminal family does not contain exactly 238 ring values.
PiCCS terminal values are not in source-major then matrix-major order.
A PiCCS terminal ring value is not canonically encoded.
The final SumCheck value differs from the reviewed joint PiCCS equation.
The PiCCS output frame is absent, malformed, or has the wrong field count.
PiRLC does not receive exactly the seventeen accepted PiCCS outputs.
A source, coefficient, or attempt counter is processed out of order.
All three sampler candidates for one coefficient equal q minus one.
A public parent-input coefficient is outside the strict 2^16 centered split domain.
PiDEC does not contain exactly sixteen ordered children.
Child commitments do not recompose to the parent commitment.
A child ring-evaluation family does not recompose to the parent family.
The fold output is not the required sixteen-child CE state.
The lifecycle fields do not satisfy 0 <= fold_index < fold_count <= 64.
A bounded sequence omits, inserts, reorders, or changes a fold, or the prior ordered children do not equal the next ordered running claims as canonical typed CE claims.
